verdict.rationale: Sift's Decisions API is a documented channel for sending business outcomes back to Sift, such as approvals, fraud blocks and chargeback cancellations, and the docs say Sift 'gets smarter the more data it has.' The pack never explicitly states that analyst review decisions retrain the model or tune Workflow rules, so the learning loop is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation that decisions and labels train or update the ML model, any feedback into rules/Workflows, evidence that review-queue actions automatically feed back, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, my review decisions and confirmed fraud outcomes feed back into the model and rules, so the system learns from every case we work

citations.quote: What actions your business is taking in response to users (e.g., approve an order, block and event due to fraud, cancel order due to chargeback, etc). You will also send this data from your application to Sift via our Decisions API.
Because Sift gets smarter the more data it has about your business
Learn to set up custom Decisions, like Ban Account or Cancel Order, that are connected to real business actions in your backend.
